description: Full ERC-20 approval history for a wallet (deeper than the free scan's recent window). Paid per-use via x402 (USDC on Polygon). If REPUTA_PAYER_PRIVATE_KEY is set, the server signs and pays autonomously (EIP-3009) and returns the full result; otherwise it returns the x402 payment requirements so the caller can pay and retry.
name: reputa_deep_approval_scan
